title: Interpolation in path-connected metric spaces using splines on embedded graphs
summary: We study a local graph-based interpolation framework for data defined on graph vertices embedded in a metric space. The resulting interpolants are constructed from variational graph splines defined on small neighborhoods, yielding continuous-domain extensions of the graph data. We analyze their behavior through energy estimates, Lipschitz continuity, and stability properties, and compare them with $k$-Nearest Neighbor ($k$NN) interpolation as a natural baseline due to its simplicity and widespread use.
